phases.name: Help from support
phases.goal: Support staff can help people who can't reach their email.
phases.demo: Maya in support sends a reset link on someone's behalf from the support screen.

tickets.title: Support can send a reset link for someone
tickets.summary: Support staff can send a reset link to a person's email from the support screen, so people who phone in get help quickly.
tickets.story: Sam phones Acme because he can't find the reset page. Maya opens his account, clicks 'Send reset link', and Sam gets the usual email.
tickets.description: A 'Send reset link' button on the support screen for one account. It sends the same email as the public page.
acceptance: The support screen has a 'Send reset link' button
Clicking it sends the normal reset email to the account's address
test_scenarios: When support clicks 'Send reset link', then one reset email goes to the account's address

user_tests.title: Send a link from the support screen
user_tests.setup: Log in as maya@acme.test (support) at http://localhost:3000/support.
user_tests.expect: A reset email for Sam appears in the test inbox.

tickets.title: Support sees when a link was sent for someone
tickets.summary: The support screen shows when a reset link was last sent and by whom, so two people don't send one at the same time.
tickets.story: Maya is about to send Sam a link and sees 'Sent 2 minutes ago by Joe'. She tells Sam to check his inbox instead.
tickets.description: Show the last reset link sent for an account, with the time and who sent it (the person or a support member).
acceptance: The support screen shows the time of the last reset link and who sent it
test_scenarios: When a link was sent by support 2 minutes ago, then the screen says 'Sent 2 minutes ago by <name>'

user_tests.title: See the last link sent
user_tests.setup: Send a reset link for sam@example.com from the support screen.
steps: Reload Sam's account on the support screen
user_tests.expect: You see 'Sent a moment ago by Maya'.
